reason: My clients' architects already do the 3D models and renders inside their fee, so I'd be paying $1,500 a home for something that's already covered. On 1-6 homes a year that margin hit isn't worth it, and my receptionist would likely never put the call through anyway.
objection: The architect already covers renders in their fee. Why would I pay $1,500 a home on top of that on my margins?
would_change_my_mind: If it were clearly something clients ask me for that the architect doesn't deliver, and I could bill it to the client as a line item so it costs me nothing.
